This reduces candidate-* count from eight to seven while retaining all bytes and all transaction records. Do not delete, unmount, change services, alter release pointers or touch the other seven candidates.
failedAttemptEvidence: This script does not modify the failed app-update staging directory, logs or stdout/stderr. Parent operator must retain the failed attempt unchanged, hash its evidence in a separate attempt directory, and explicitly restore the chosen staging name before retrying; exact staging paths were not supplied to this reviewer.
limitations: Occupancy checks are a point-in-time observation. Execution must recheck them under the same management lock and stop on any mismatch; unrelated root operators must not concurrently mutate the candidate.
